claims.claim: Bounded TASK_AUTHORING ledger entries contain only id and CLAIM_NOW or PROOF_LATER phase. Normalized ledger material participates in Stage-2 and serialized Brain decision identity; ledger substitution fails identity revalidation.
Prospective AUTHOR_TASK ingress requires exact final acceptance-id coverage and rejects missing, duplicate, extra, substituted or PROOF_LATER ledger entries before canonical mutation.
All-CLAIM_NOW candidates use the existing frozen TASK validator and canonicalization path without writing ledger or proof-phase fields into TASK bytes.
Proof-phase classification remains Brain-owned; deterministic changes enforce declared shape, tokens, coverage and identity without interpreting acceptance prose.
The repository return contract defines both phases, ledger bounds and Stage-2 reconciliation of later-proof requirements onto existing verification, constraint or non-goal surfaces before handoff.
Non-TASK audited flows retain their existing Stage-2 fields and reject TASK proof-phase ledger material.
Identical historical TASK replay remains non-mutating and returns before the new ledger gate; prospective identities and revisions encounter the gate.

Focused regression fixtures cover valid authoring, ledger identity tampering, malformed or missing declarations, ingress coverage failures, frozen TASK parsing and cross-flow rejection while retaining existing freshness fixtures.
